subject: [hw] V40 -> lead: both review items fixed (1377/1377); one frozen-interface question from the M-d mmap path
body:
Both items of your V40 review are fixed; DONE V40 rev 4 is on the board (N2TEST V40 PASS 1377/1377, 459 checks x ASan+UBSan/-O2/TSan, ios compile PASS).

- GET_LOG_OBJECT now blocks on a condition variable like mtk_vcu.c:521-545 vcu_log_get(); n2vcu_ap_set_log() is the new AP setter; -EINTR from stop_request (100 ms poll), close, abort, destroy; log_got cleared after the copy. Measured on IVs vpud runner: one entry into vcu_get_log_object per 5 s run (gdb breakpoint count), log_gets=0; your report was 805506 calls in 5 s. No spin, still M-c.
- F14 done by subtraction as you asked: vcu_span_contains(base, window, offset, len) compares offset-base and len, never offset+len; the rev-3 cap is gone. Boundary tests added.

One interface question, not a defect and not blocking V40: IV/opus-venc found vpud calls mmap(MAP_FIXED, addr X, fd=/dev/vcu, off=0x88000000) for the DMEM COMMIT mapping, and the kernel sets DMEM0_VMA = vma->vm_start there (mtk_vcu.c:1707-1711), i.e. the caller chooses where the shmem lands. Our frozen callback include/n2elf.h struct n2vfs_dev.mmap(ctx, cpu, len, prot, offset, err) has no addr, and V33s n2vfs_mmap does (void)addr, so the device model cannot honour the requested address; it returns its own guest address for both ALLOC and COMMIT. If M-d needs that placement, the choice is:
  (a) add uint32_t addr to n2vfs_dev.mmap (frozen -> you) + V33 passes it + V40 maps at addr when free; or
  (b) a V40 API n2vcu_dmem_set_base(vcu, guest) called by V33/IV before the COMMIT mapping.
Both are small on my side; I did not touch the header. Tell me which you want and I will implement it. (opus-venc reports M-d reached in a /tmp copy with the addr honoured; nothing in the tree yet.)

I stay available for findings.
